sections.heading: 1. Researcher declaration and agreement
paragraphs: I confirm that I am a qualified researcher purchasing solely for lawful laboratory research, not for human or veterinary use. I understand that the Seller may request additional information or supporting documentation if questions arise about my eligibility, the information I provide, or my intended research use. I agree to provide that information upon request, subject to the clarification and cancellation provisions below, and understand that my order may be paused or declined if those questions remain unresolved. By selecting “I agree,” I acknowledge and accept these conditions.

This agreement states my researcher representations and the conditions for additional information before fulfillment. If I cannot or choose not to provide requested information, I may cancel the affected unshipped items and receive the refund described below. Failure to complete an information request does not, by itself, cause my payment to be forfeited.

sections.heading: 2. Parties, scope, and related terms
paragraphs: “Seller” means the merchant identified on the store and with the order. “Buyer,” “I,” and “my” mean the person accepting this agreement and any purchaser that person is authorized to represent. “Order” means the specific purchase submitted to that Seller. PRISM provides checkout technology and associated verification records; it is not the Seller merely because its branding appears at checkout, unless separately identified as the merchant for that purchase.

This agreement supplements the disclosed checkout terms, product restrictions, and Seller policies for researcher representations and related information requests. Its cancellation and refund protections form part of the terms for those requests and are not reduced by a general “all sales final” statement. More favorable applicable rights remain available. Acceptance alone does not authorize payment, create an order, or change an order total.

sections.heading: 3. Qualifications, capacity, and truthful information
paragraphs: I represent that I possess the training, knowledge, and access to appropriate laboratory facilities and procedures necessary for the ordered materials and their intended lawful research use. I remain responsible for obtaining any supervision, permits, or institutional authorizations required for the work.

I will provide accurate, current identity, contact, category, and organization information. I will not use another person's identity, claim credentials I do not hold, or submit misleading documents. If acting for an organization, I confirm my authority to make the purchase and representations on its behalf. I will correct a material error before proceeding and notify the Seller if I discover an error affecting an order already submitted.

sections.heading: 4. Independent, university, and institutional categories
paragraphs: I will select the category that accurately describes the capacity in which I am purchasing. Independent researchers must satisfy the same applicable research-use, qualification, and legal requirements as organizational purchasers. Selecting Independent does not permit a personal, household, human-use, or veterinary-use purchase prohibited by the checkout terms. A personal email address does not, by itself, establish or disprove qualifications.

If I select University or Institution / laboratory, I will identify the appropriate organization and use an email address I am entitled to use for that relationship. I will not select an unrelated organization to satisfy a domain requirement. I confirm that my relationship to the selected organization and my authority to make this purchase are accurately represented. A category change must reflect my actual circumstances.

sections.heading: 5. Laboratory research restrictions
paragraphs: I will acquire and use the ordered materials solely for lawful laboratory research within the restrictions stated for the products. I will not administer them to a person or animal, consume them, use them for self-experimentation, or supply them to another person for those purposes. I will not present them as a medicine, treatment, preventive measure, diagnostic product, food, supplement, or other product for a use the Seller does not lawfully offer.

I am responsible for determining the legal and institutional requirements applicable where the materials are ordered, received, handled, stored, transferred, and disposed of. Transfers must comply with those requirements and the conditions of sale. A research-use label, checkout acceptance, or this agreement does not authorize prohibited conduct, restricted research, or clinical activity.

sections.heading: 6. Appropriate handling and research responsibility
paragraphs: Before ordering, I will determine whether the laboratory has personnel, equipment, storage, handling procedures, and waste-disposal arrangements suitable for the materials. I will consider the product and safety information provided and obtain appropriate guidance when the work requires it. I will not proceed with a use I cannot perform lawfully and competently.

These responsibilities do not release the Seller from its obligations concerning product descriptions, lawful sale, or fulfillment. This agreement does not establish that a material is safe, suitable for a particular experiment, approved by a regulator, or appropriate for human or veterinary use. Applicable rights and remedies concerning the products remain available.

sections.heading: 7. Requests for additional information
paragraphs: If questions arise about my eligibility, the accuracy of my information, authority to purchase, or research purpose, the Seller may request information reasonably connected to resolving them. As relevant, this may concern my research role, an identified organization, purchasing authority, intended laboratory use, or arrangements for lawful receipt and handling. A request must be proportionate to the matter requiring clarification.

The Seller will identify the information or documents needed, explain the subject requiring clarification sufficiently for me to respond, state a reasonable response deadline, and provide a contact for questions. The request will explain that I may cancel affected unshipped items if I cannot or do not wish to respond. It does not authorize an additional charge or a fee for considering my response.

sections.heading: 8. Responding, clarifying, and protecting sensitive information
paragraphs: If I wish the affected order to proceed, I agree to provide a truthful and reasonably complete response to a relevant request within the stated deadline, or to contact the Seller before that deadline to explain a difficulty and request clarification or reasonable additional time. The Seller may decline to fulfill the affected items if the information reasonably needed to resolve the question remains unavailable. My obligation to respond is subject to my right to cancel unshipped items under this agreement.

I may ask why a particular item is needed, whether an alternative document would answer the question, and whether irrelevant or sensitive information may be redacted. I am not required by this agreement to disclose passwords, email verification codes, complete payment-card credentials, unrelated medical information, or confidential research details that are unnecessary for the stated purpose. I must not redact information in a way that makes what I submit misleading. If a sufficient and appropriate response cannot be agreed upon, I may choose cancellation rather than provide the disputed information.

sections.heading: 9. Pending requests, fulfillment, and shipment delays
paragraphs: The Seller may pause affected unshipped items while a relevant question remains unresolved and decline them if it cannot determine that fulfillment is appropriate. It will communicate a decision affecting fulfillment and the cancellation or refund outcome. A pending request does not permit indefinite retention of payment or eliminate a shipment commitment or refund obligation imposed by law.

If fulfillment cannot occur within the applicable shipping time, the Seller will provide the notice, revised estimate, choice about delay, cancellation, and refund required by law. This agreement is not advance consent to an unlimited delay. I retain an applicable cancellation right even if I previously agreed to supply information or allow time for a response. Shipment means physical delivery of the goods to the carrier, not creation of a shipping label.

sections.heading: 10. Cancellation when information is unavailable or declined
paragraphs: If I am unable or unwilling to provide requested supporting information, I may notify the Seller that I wish to cancel the affected items before they are shipped. I may use the Seller's support contact provided on the store or with the order; no particular legal phrase is required, provided that my message identifies the order and clearly requests cancellation. I do not have to establish my research qualifications as a condition of receiving a refund already due for canceled unshipped items.

If the Seller declines the affected unshipped items, or cancels them because an information request remains unresolved, the same refund protections apply. The Seller will confirm which items are canceled and identify the amount to be returned or the payment authorization to be released. An incomplete response, a missed information deadline, or my decision not to proceed does not create a verification penalty, administrative charge, restocking charge for those unshipped items, or forfeiture of their purchase price.

sections.heading: 11. Refund amount for canceled unshipped orders
paragraphs: When an entire order is canceled or declined under these information-request provisions before any of it is shipped, the Seller will refund the full amount it collected for that order, including the product price, associated taxes, and shipping, handling, insurance, or other order charges for services that will not be performed. The Seller will not subtract a verification charge, its payment-processing expense, or a cancellation penalty from that refund. If payment was never collected, there is no captured purchase amount to refund.

When only part of an order is canceled, the refund will include the amount paid for the canceled unshipped items, their associated taxes, and any shipping or other charges attributable to services that will not be performed, with any further adjustment required by applicable law. The Seller will explain the calculation without converting the cancellation into a penalty. This provision does not automatically refund the price of goods already shipped or services actually performed; rights concerning those items remain governed by applicable law and the Seller policies accepted for the order.

sections.heading: 12. Refund method, timing, and payment authorizations
paragraphs: The Seller will issue the refund promptly, within the time required by applicable law, using the original payment method where available. It will not require store credit, a voucher, replacement purchase, or another order to obtain a monetary refund due here. If the original route cannot receive it, the Seller will arrange a lawful alternative and communicate the amount and method without a verification fee.

A temporary authorization differs from a completed charge. If an authorization has not been captured, the Seller will take appropriate steps to cancel or release it; if funds have been captured, it must issue the applicable refund. When funds appear in my account can depend on my payment provider, but that does not extend the Seller's deadline to act. I may request confirmation of the refund amount and submission date.

sections.heading: 13. Delivered goods, corrections, and payment disputes
paragraphs: For a partly or fully shipped order, the Seller and I must distinguish unshipped items from goods already sent. A later information request does not automatically create a penalty or make delivered goods refundable without regard to their condition, applicable law, and the disclosed return policy. Incorrect shipments, damage, non-delivery, disputed charges, and other fulfillment problems remain subject to their applicable rights and remedies.

I may contact the Seller with the order identifier and problem so it can respond. That contact does not suspend a dispute deadline or become a prerequisite to a right that cannot lawfully be conditioned on it. This agreement does not prevent contact with a payment provider or appropriate authority, waive a right to dispute an unauthorized or incorrect charge, or restrict a refund or other remedy available under applicable law.

sections.heading: 14. Information, correspondence, and acceptance records
paragraphs: The Seller and PRISM may retain researcher information and acceptance records reasonably needed to document the transaction and representations made, subject to applicable privacy notices and law. The record may include name, email, category, applicable organization information, mailbox-confirmation reference, agreement text and version, and acceptance date and time.

I will keep contact details accessible and pending-order information accurate. I may verify unfamiliar requests with the Seller before sending documents. Acceptance does not enroll me in marketing, authorize a subscription, grant account access, or require unrelated information. Device recognition remains a separate choice.

sections.heading: 15. Electronic acceptance and applicable version
paragraphs: By affirmatively selecting the checkbox labeled “I agree” and continuing, I intend to accept this Researcher Agreement electronically. I have the opportunity to open and read it before selecting the checkbox. The accepted text, version, and acceptance record identify what I agreed to. A later revision does not silently replace an earlier accepted version or remove a refund right that has already arisen.

I may retain this agreement and request its version through the Seller's support contact. Recognized details do not authorize future charges or excuse inaccurate information. I must correct changed circumstances and complete any required acceptance. Separate order declarations remain applicable when researcher details are recognized.

sections.heading: 16. Preservation of rights and final acknowledgment
paragraphs: This agreement does not restrict mandatory rights or excuse unlawful conduct. If a provision cannot lawfully apply, that does not enlarge the Seller's right to retain payment or eliminate the remaining protections. No new choice of court, jurisdiction, arbitration process, limitation of liability, or obligation to pay the Seller's legal expenses is created here.

I acknowledge that truthful information and lawful laboratory use are conditions of proceeding. If the Seller reasonably requests information to resolve a relevant question, I must respond appropriately to continue with the affected order or may cancel its unshipped items. Unresolved eligibility questions alone do not permit the Seller to keep payment for goods it will not ship; the cancellation and refund protections above apply.
